title: A very moving and...
text:
A very moving and powerful place to visit, I definitely recommend doing this tour with the Skip the line and priority access to the Black Madonna.

There were huge lines to get in, if you don’t have all day to waste, skip the line is definitely the way to go
author: Julie_S

title: So much to explore!!!
text: Would like more time to explore!!!! Don’t get time to go museum snd wine tasting…Awesome cathedral and scenery is magnificent!
author: Claudia_G

title: Great Monserrat Tour
text:
Marvelous tour of Montserrat and was able to get up close with the Black Madonna. The views are breathtaking. We had the small group tour with an excellent guide, Ivan. He was informative, attentive and very kind to one and all. A great tour guide.
Wine, liquor and cheese tasting was tasty.
A wonderful tour. I would recommend this tour.
author: rlee8788

title: Montserrat a once in a lifetime visit
text: It is a very full day but such a great experience. Jonathan our guide was very knowledgeable and had a great sense of humour. His instructions were precise and easy to follow. All in all an amazing outing. So pleased we went to Montserrat
author: tonjencooke

title: Montserrat & Black Madonna with Ms Miri
text: Our tour guide, Ms Miri was a very jolly and amazing girl. She explained everything so beautifully and took care of each and everyone in our group. She even gave us recommendations for the best restaurants and places to visit at Barcelona. Montserrat is a mystical place with picturesque spots. Black Madonna was the highlight. Funicular ride was a thrilling one. Local delicacy of fresh cheese and honey was a tasty one. Audio-visual tour was a good one too. Cannot miss this half-day Montserrat tour with Julia travels.
author: Sunshine67587283218

title: Excellent tour and guide
text:
The tour with Julia Travel was excellent.
 The coach was very comfortable and timely.
The guide Lorena was very informative and knowledgeable.  I am hearing impaired and Lorena went out of her way to keep me informed. I couldn't have asked for more and would definitely recommend the tour by Julia Travel with Lorena as guide.
John
author: johnmU835RB

title: Love the tour. Must do
text: Great tour. Would do it again. Beautiful views up the mountain. A lot of time to see everything and to grab a good lunch.
author: Connie_S

title: Montserrat
text: Ivan was exceptionally welcoming with Julia Travel.  Informative and directive for what was an potentially huge outing.  It deserves more time then I booked for this tour
